from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """A single paper document extracted from the collection."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of the paper")
    citations: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of all papers referenced in this document's bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregated data from all provided documents."""
    papers: list[Paper]
